title: Two parts incident to each matching edge
statement: Let $q,k\in\mathbb{N}$, choose a perfect matching in the complete $q$-partite graph with $k$ vertices per part, and take any edge of the matching. Exactly two parts have a matching edge incident to one of their vertices at some position; equivalently, the set of such parts has cardinality $2$.
hypotheses_covered: a perfect matching in the complete q-partite graph
